Liimitud parketi jaoks valitakse aluspin: For glued parquet, we choose a flooring adhesive compatible with the substrate, primer and wood. Laminate designed for floating installation must not be glued to the substrate on your own initiative. Oiled and varnished wood require different care products; we avoid wet washing and use felt pads under furniture.
